readings: Link each advanced behaviour record to its transaction (`translink` = `transreg`), dropping any without a match, and group by order type mix (`ordertypedist`), keeping a separate group for records with no mix recorded. For each mix, count the distinct transactions, and work out that count's share of the total across all mixes. Take the simple average of those shares across mixes as the baseline. Return only the mixes whose share is above the baseline, showing the order type mix, the count of distinct transactions, the share, and how far the share is above the baseline average share, with no rounding.
queries:
WITH g AS (
  SELECT t.ordertypedist AS mix, COUNT(DISTINCT t.transreg) AS cnt
  FROM advancedbehavior a
  JOIN transactionrecord t ON a.translink = t.transreg
  GROUP BY t.ordertypedist
),
s AS (
  SELECT mix, cnt, cnt * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(cnt) FROM g) AS share
  FROM g
),
b AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS base FROM s
)
SELECT s.mix AS ordertypedist, s.cnt AS transaction_count, s.share AS share, s.share - b.base AS above_baseline
FROM s, b
WHERE s.share > b.base;
